title: Characterization of eigenfunctions of the Laplacian having exponential growth
summary: In 1993, Robert Strichartz proved a characterization for the bounded eigenfunctions of Laplacian $Δ=-\sum_{j=1}^d \frac{\partial^2}{\partial x_j^2} $ on $\mathbb{R}^d$: If $\left\{f_k \right\}_{k\in \mathbb{Z}}$ be a doubly infinite sequence of functions on $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that $Δf_k=f_{k+1}$ and $ \|f_k\|_{L^{\infty}(\mathbb{R}^d)} \leq C$ for all $ k \in \mathbb{Z}$, for some $C>0$, then $f_0$ is an eigenfunction of $Δ$. Observing the existence of unbounded eigenfunctions of the Laplacian, Howard and Reese generalized Strichartz's theorem to characterize eigenfunctions of the Laplacian…
